resources.string: The catalogue grows to 9,999 objects across the Solar System and the deep sky.
Expanded tracking uses verified JPL and satellite references, with explicit limits for historical or unavailable data.
Graphics pack 1.8 adds five photographs and independent thumbnails, downloaded individually and cached offline.
Catalogue calculations, search and data refresh are optimized for the larger collection.
Location subpages remain fully editable. Enable or disable each custom value only from Location management.
More compact Location cards and an always-checked, disabled Resumption checkbox make the controls clearer.
